_about: PARKED. The grab and throw family of ../m0-rich.md (wave 7 in its table; brought forward as wave 4 by the EP). Not loaded, not hashed. kind, direction and uses are copied from moveset.antihero.m0.json. Legal screened the Legal lines: GO (docs/legal/rule-of-cool-screen.md, the waves 3 and 4 section).

rules.source: docs/design/control-rules.md sections 4 and 9; moveset-rules.md section 11(d); spec-wounds.md 1d
rules.throw: on the tick after the hold; a launch at x0.8 of a heavy; a decisive exchange
rules.whiffs: against a dodge: 20 ticks open and a 1.5 s cooldown
rules.oneArm: the grab still works; two-arm throws are dropped; the throw does x0.8

distances._note: the reach lands at the hand's contact distance to the chest; the hold pulls the rival in to 36 u, inside minSeparation 45, so it needs the contact block's proposed clinch floor (32)

directorGates: a brunt target is behind him and the planner scores it above every target in front, after the turn's penalty
it follows only a heavy, an ender, a guard break or a finisher strike
the body is held, not flying: never a ping-pong's return blow or ender
the held fighter cannot act for the 10 ticks
turnThrow.fromAGrab: the away throw: back throw when nothing stands behind him, turn throw when a brunt target does or when he has one arm

held._about: what the sim must carry for the pinned ragdoll (Animation's ask)
held.rule: the held fighter is placed at the holder's socket every tick and cannot act; he is released on the throw's release tick with the throw's launch

fallback: if no throw is left for the direction held, the neutral throw plays

pieces.grip: one hand to the collar (the chest socket)

new: the reach: arm at full length, hand open and clawed

pieces._legal: the grip is on the collar or an arm: never the throat, the face or the hair, and no lift by the throat or the face
pieces.look: A clawed hand shot out flat at the collar, the arm one line with the back leg; the other hand open at his ribs.

ticks.inside: the last 10 ticks of the rush

new: the lunge: the reach laid out behind a rush

pieces.look: The same reach on the end of a rush, his whole body a line behind the hand.

pieces.grip: the gripping hand pulls in; the forearm guard lies across the collar

new: the hold: the rival pulled in chest to shoulder

pieces._legal: the forearm lies across the collar, never the throat; no lift by the throat or the face, and no rival held up at arm's length
pieces.look: He pulls the rival in against his shoulder, forearm guard across the collar, his head beside theirs.

throw.vector: across: the planner's long-haul candidates, brunt targets ahead included

new: load: his back turned into the rival, hips under theirs
release: both arms thrown out in one line

pieces._legal: half a turn at most before the release
pieces.look: He turns his back into the rival and throws them past his hip, both arms ending in one long line after them.

throw.vector: across, lower and shorter than the hurl

new: load: the arm bent, the rival swung to his side
release: the arm straight, at full reach

pieces._legal: half a turn at most: never a swing of several turns, and never by the legs or a tail
pieces.look: A half turn of the shoulders and the arm straightens like a thrown blade, letting go at full reach.

pieces.grip: both forearm guards under the rival

throw.vector: the drive: down and forward, 25 to 50 degrees below level (launch-vectors.md)

new: load: the rival lifted to shoulder height on both guards
release: driven down ahead of him, his weight following

pieces._legal: no press held overhead, and no body broken across a knee or a shoulder (also out of key art and cinematics)
pieces.look: He lifts the rival on both forearm guards and drives them down ahead of him, falling in behind them.

throw.vector: the drive; the straight crater slam only under its gates

new: load: risen a body length, the rival hanging from the grip
release: the arm whipped down past his own knee

pieces.look: He rises a body length with them and throws them down past his own knee.

pieces.grip: both arms round the middle (the gut socket)

throw.vector: across, behind him: over his shoulder, never through him

new: load: dropped under the rival's arm, arms locked round their middle
release: arched back, the rival leaving over his shoulder

pieces._legal: the rival is let go in the air: no drop held to the ground
pieces.look: He drops under the rival's arm, locks both arms round their middle and arches back so they go over his shoulder and behind him.

throw.vector: the planner's vector at the target behind him; from a grab, across behind him

new: the turn: mid-pivot, the rival carried at a bent arm on his outside
release: his back to where he first faced, the arm thrown out

pieces._legal: one half turn: the body goes round him, never through him and never further
pieces.look: He pivots half a turn on the spot with the rival carried round him at a bent arm, and lets go with his back to where he first faced.

new: load: the tail coiled, his hands open at his sides
release: the tail snapped straight

pieces._legal: a hair, cloth or metal tail, never a furred or reptilian one; no more than half a turn
pieces.look: The tail coils the rival's middle and whips them away while his open hands never leave his sides.

pieces.grip: a shoulder to the middle, one arm hooked behind the back

new: the hit: shoulder in, body flat, one arm round

pieces.look: At full sprint: the plated shoulder into the middle, one arm hooked behind the rival's back.

throw.vector: released along the ground: a slide, or a brunt if something stands in the way

new: the carry: the rival folded over his shoulder, his body low and driving

pieces.look: He keeps driving: the rival folded over his shoulder, the ground tearing under their back, until he lets them go into whatever is ahead.

pieces.grip: one hand to the collar from above

new: the catch: head first from above, one arm reaching down

pieces.look: Head first from above, one arm reaching down to take the collar.

throw.vector: straight down when the rival is directly below (the crater slam's gate); otherwise the drive

new: release: thrown down the last body length as he pulls up

pieces.look: He keeps falling with them and throws them down the last body length, pulling up himself.

pieces.grip: the hand that blocked catches the arm (the chest socket until an arm socket exists)

new: the catch: the blocked arm taken at the guard
release: his hip under the arm, the rival going over

pieces.look: He takes the blocked arm, turns his hip under it and lets the rival's own push carry them over.

pieces.grip: a leg hooked behind the rival's lead leg (the legs socket)

throw.vector: none: the rival goes down where he stands

new: the sweep: guard still up on the good arm, one leg hooking low

pieces.look: The guard stays up on the good arm while a low hook of the leg takes the rival's feet.
